insights.summary: Plaud AI had zero media coverage this week across 18 Tier-1 English outlets, indicating a complete absence from earned media conversations. This represents a critical PR gap that needs immediate attention to build brand visibility and market positioning.
insights: Zero share of voice suggests Plaud AI is not part of current AI productivity conversations in mainstream business media
Absence from financial press (Bloomberg, CNBC) indicates missed opportunities for investor and enterprise audience engagement
The 'AI Note Taker' to 'AI Work Companion' positioning shift requires proactive media strategy to reshape narrative
Competitors also show zero coverage, suggesting either a quiet news cycle or broader category invisibility in mainstream press
actions: Launch proactive media outreach campaign targeting business and tech reporters with Plaud AI's work companion vision
Develop newsworthy angles around the capture-extract-utilize workflow and productivity metrics
Pitch exclusive demos and case studies to Bloomberg and CNBC to establish financial press relationships
Create thought leadership content positioning CEO/founders as AI workplace transformation experts
Partner with industry analysts or conduct proprietary research to generate data-driven news hooks
insights.risk: Continued media invisibility could allow competitors to dominate the AI productivity narrative while Plaud AI remains unknown to key decision-makers.
insights.opportunity: The quiet competitive landscape presents a chance to break through with compelling stories about transforming work intelligence and productivity.
